sentences: This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
It would provide about 7/12 of the estimated annual funding for 2016-2017, plus full-year Budget measures.
The remaining 5/12 would come from a separate supply bill, ensuring enough money for the first part of the year.
changes: The bill would appropriate money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
It would set the appropriation at 7/12 of the estimated annual amount plus full-year Budget measures.
The bill would work with a supply bill to cover the other 5/12 of the annual funding.
summary.affected: The Parliamentary Departments are the affected entities.

speeches.speaker: Peter Hendy
speeches.brief: The Appropriation Bill (No. 2) 2016-2017 seeks just under $9 billion for non‑ordinary annual services, including $4.9 billion for the National Broadband Network, $1.4 billion for defence (with an additional $700 million for the 2016 defence white paper), $544 million for infrastructure programs such as Roads to Recovery and Western Sydney airport, and $310 million for agriculture, including a $50 million national water infrastructure loan facility.

speeches.speaker: Peter Hendy
speeches.brief: The Appropriation (Parliamentary Departments) Bill (No. 1) 2016-2017 seeks just over $147 million for the operations of the Department of the Senate, the Department of the House of Representatives, the Department of Parliamentary Services, and the Parliamentary Budget Office, including over $25 million for Parliament House maintenance.
